nodes.title: Berger’s four-frame curvature estimate
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (T : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T y x z w) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T x y w z) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = T z w x y) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w + T y z x w + T z x y w = 0) → ∀ (a b : ℝ), (∀ x y : V, ‖x‖ = 1 → ‖y‖ = 1 → inner ℝ x y = 0 → a ≤ T x y x y ∧ T x y x y ≤ b) → ∀ e : Fin 4 → V, Orthonormal ℝ e → |T (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (e 3)| ≤ 2 * (b - a) / 3

nodes.title: An algebraic curvature tensor with zero sectional values is zero

nodes.title: Uniform weighted positivity from strict quarter-pinching
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (T : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T y x z w) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T x y w z) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = T z w x y) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w + T y z x w + T z x y w = 0) → ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → b < 4 * a → (∀ x y : V, ‖x‖ = 1 → ‖y‖ = 1 → inner ℝ x y = 0 → a ≤ T x y x y ∧ T x y x y ≤ b) → ∀ (e : Fin 4 → V), Orthonormal ℝ e → ∀ (lam mu : ℝ), -1 ≤ lam → lam ≤ 1 → -1 ≤ mu → mu ≤ 1 → (4 * a - b) / 3 * ((1 + lam ^ 2) * (1 + mu ^ 2)) ≤ T (e 0) (e 2) (e 0) (e 2) + lam ^ 2 * T (e 0) (e 3) (e 0) (e 3) + mu ^ 2 * T (e 1) (e 2) (e 1) (e 2) + lam ^ 2 * mu ^ 2 * T (e 1) (e 3) (e 1) (e 3) - 2 * lam * mu * T (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (e 3)

nodes.title: Sectional pinching bounds a mixed curvature difference
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (T : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T y x z w) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T x y w z) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = T z w x y) → ∀ (a b : ℝ), (∀ x y : V, ‖x‖ = 1 → ‖y‖ = 1 → inner ℝ x y = 0 → a ≤ T x y x y ∧ T x y x y ≤ b) → ∀ e : Fin 4 → V, Orthonormal ℝ e → |T (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (e 3) - T (e 0) (e 3) (e 1) (e 2)| ≤ b - a

nodes.title: Signed double polarization of a quadrilinear form
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (T : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (x y z w : V), T (x + z) (y + w) (x + z) (y + w) - T (x + z) (y - w) (x + z) (y - w) - T (x - z) (y + w) (x - z) (y + w) + T (x - z) (y - w) (x - z) (y - w) = 4 * (T x y z w + T z y x w + T x w z y + T z w x y)

nodes.title: An algebraic curvature tensor is determined by its sectional diagonal
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (T : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T y x z w) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = -T x y w z) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w = T z w x y) → (∀ x y z w : V, T x y z w + T y z x w + T z x y w = 0) → (∀ x y : V, T x y x y = 0) → T = 0
